title: Whimsical Silver Multi-Gem Celestial Ring
storyHtml:
A baguette, a tiny heart, a little star — a scatter of coloured crystals across a softly sculpted, molten-looking band. Playful, personal, and unlike anything else in the drawer.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Mixed-cut 5A zircon in yellow, olive & pink
